stock_movements_sign_check.name: stock_movements_sign_check
stock_movements_sign_check.value:
("stock_movements"."type" = 'receive' and "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("stock_movements"."type" in ('consume', 'waste') and "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0)
        or ("stock_movements"."type" = 'sale' and "stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0)
        or ("stock_movements"."type" = 'adjust' and "stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0)

public.stock_count_line_books.definition:
select
      l.stock_count_id,
      l.item_id,
      coalesce(sum(m.quantity) filter (where m.occurred_at <= l.counted_at), 0) as book_quantity
    from stock_count_lines l
    left join stock_movements m on m.item_id = l.item_id
    where l.counted_at is not null
    group by l.stock_count_id, l.item_id
public.stock_count_line_books.name: stock_count_line_books

public.sale_import_summaries.definition:
select
      i.id as import_id,
      i.store_id,
      count(s.id)::integer as sale_count,
      coalesce(sum(s.quantity), 0)::integer as quantity,
      coalesce(sum(s.amount), 0)::bigint as amount,
      min(s.sold_at) as first_sold_at,
      max(s.sold_at) as last_sold_at
    from sale_imports i
    left join sale_records s on s.import_id = i.id
    group by i.id
public.sale_import_summaries.name: sale_import_summaries

public.item_cost_changes.definition:
select distinct on (r.item_id)
      r.item_id,
      r.store_id,
      r.previous_unit_cost,
      r.unit_cost,
      r.occurred_at as changed_at
    from (
      select
        m.item_id,
        m.store_id,
        m.unit_cost,
        m.occurred_at,
        m.created_at,
        lag(m.unit_cost) over (partition by m.item_id order by m.occurred_at, m.created_at) as previous_unit_cost
      from stock_movements m
      where m.type = 'receive' and m.unit_cost is not null
    ) r
    where r.previous_unit_cost <> r.unit_cost
    order by r.item_id, r.occurred_at desc, r.created_at desc
public.item_cost_changes.name: item_cost_changes

public.item_latest_costs.definition:
select distinct on (m.item_id)
      m.item_id,
      m.store_id,
      m.unit_cost,
      m.occurred_at as received_at
    from stock_movements m
    where m.type = 'receive' and m.unit_cost is not null
    order by m.item_id, m.occurred_at desc, m.created_at desc
public.item_latest_costs.name: item_latest_costs

public.item_stock_levels.definition:
select
      i.id as item_id,
      i.store_id,
      coalesce(sum(m.quantity), 0) as quantity,
      coalesce(sum(m.quantity), 0) <= i.min_stock as is_low
    from items i
    left join stock_movements m on m.item_id = i.id
    where i.archived_at is null
    group by i.id
public.item_stock_levels.name: item_stock_levels

public.lot_stock_levels.definition:
select
      l.id as lot_id,
      l.item_id,
      l.store_id,
      l.expires_on,
      sum(m.quantity) as quantity
    from stock_lots l
    join stock_movements m on m.lot_id = l.id
    group by l.id
    having sum(m.quantity) > 0
public.lot_stock_levels.name: lot_stock_levels
